description: This file is the main entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global styles, and the main App component, then initializes and renders the application inside the DOM element with ID 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree, starting with <React.StrictMode><App/></React.StrictMode>.
